title: Hello in 5 languages
text:
👋 Happy New Year! Start 2027 by saying hello in 5 languages with Leo and friends:

🇹🇭 สวัสดี (sa-wàt-dii)
🇫🇷 Bonjour (bon-ZHOOR)
🇪🇸 ¡Hola! (OH-lah)
🇮🇹 Buongiorno (bwon-JOR-noh)
🇬🇧 Hello!

Which one will your family learn this year? 5 minutes a day, together 😊

title: Here comes la Befana!
text:
🧹🌕 Tomorrow night in Italy, la Befana flies over the rooftops on her broomstick and leaves sweets for good children (and a lump of coal for naughty ones!). Lupo spotted her across the moon!

🇮🇹 Arriva la Befana! (ah-REE-vah lah beh-FAH-nah) = Here comes the Befana!

text:

🇫🇷 la galette des rois (lah gah-LET day RWAH) = the kings' cake

text:

title: The memory of a fish!
